exposure: imaging findings (portal venous gas, pneumatosis, abdominal free air)
outcome: five distinct clusters of acquired neonatal intestinal injury
cohort: Patients admitted to the University of Florida Shands Neonatal Intensive Care Unit between January 2013 and September 2019 who were diagnosed with an intestinal injury, had specific imaging findings, or underwent abdominal interventions.
finding: Unsupervised machine learning successfully identified five distinct clusters of acquired neonatal intestinal injuries, each with unique features related to mortality, inflammation, maturity, feeding status, and intestinal necrosis.
